# Muhammad Ali Ridho

> Portfolio of Muhammad Ali Ridho — Statistician in the government sector, practical workflow automation builder, and writer based in South Kalimantan, Indonesia. Philosophy: "Less manual work, zero server bills, and tools people actually use."

Muhammad Ali Ridho holds a B.Ed. in Mathematics from Universitas Lambung Mangkurat (2019–2024). In his current role as a government-sector Statistician, he manages and analyzes education data workflows (EMIS, Verval PD, PDUM, TKA) across 20 districts and builds zero-server-cost internal portals, dashboards, and automation pipelines inside tools staff already use every day.

## Pages

- [Home](https://muhammadaliridho.my.id/): Overview of Muhammad Ali Ridho, philosophy, career highlights, selected projects, and recent Medium articles.

- [Experience](https://muhammadaliridho.my.id/experience): Career timeline across government sector data automation, Yayasan Hasnur Centre (HAFECS), Marbelika, and KSI Ulul Albab.
- [Portfolio](https://muhammadaliridho.my.id/portfolio): Case studies for 16 production systems built across Google Apps Script, Python automation, Next.js, Multi-Agent orchestration, and Obsidian.
- [Articles](https://muhammadaliridho.my.id/articles): Essays and reflections synced from Medium (@mhmmdaliridh).

## Core Expertise

- **Zero-Cost Operational Web Apps**: Building internal reporting portals, verifier workspaces, and compliance surveys directly on Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, and Google Drive API (`SI-PRIMA`, `SI-PELITA`, `SI-PERKAS`, `Survei IKM`, `Monitor BAP EMIS`).
- **Statistical & Education Data Workflows**: Large-scale EMIS API synchronization, NPSN/NSM reconciliation across 20 districts, and Looker Studio analytics dashboards.
- **Browser & Document Automation**: Automating repetitive national web portal tasks and multi-step PDF/Excel pipelines using Python (Playwright, Selenium, OpenPyXL).
- **AI Multi-Agent & Second Brain Systems**: Designing role-based multi-agent orchestration (`Minerva` on Hermes Agent) paired two-way with a structured 270+ note Obsidian knowledge vault.
- **Modern Web Development**: Shipping fast, responsive full-stack web apps with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase.

## Highlighted Projects

- **SI-PRIMA**: 5-view Google Apps Script & Sheets achievement tracking portal across 20 districts (`https://s.id/SI-PRIMA`).
- **Monitor BAP EMIS & WhatsApp Recap Generator**: Live EMIS REST API synchronization into Google Sheets with 1-click WhatsApp recap generation.
- **Public Satisfaction Survey / IKM System**: PermenPANRB 14/2017 compliant 9-element survey app with automatic NRR, IKM, and Mutu A–D scoring.
- **Hermes Multi-Agent Ecosystem ("Minerva")**: Lead orchestrator with 6 specialized role agents, 9+ daily cron automations, and Telegram Forum Topics routing.
- **Obsidian Second Brain & AI Agent Memory Vault**: "One Vault, Two Views" Markdown knowledge system synced via Syncthing and hourly GitHub backups (270+ notes).
- **Penmadbanjar.com**: SSR Next.js 16 + TypeScript education portal and CMS built in a team (`https://penmadbanjar.com`).
- **Taskly**: Personal Neobrutalism to-do list and Kanban workspace built with Next.js, Supabase Realtime, and Google OAuth (`https://taskly.muhammadaliridho.my.id`).
